__comment: The real trust. Principal is Snowflake's OWN IAM user, not your account root -- root would let anything in your account assume the role, and it is not what Snowflake presents. The external id is what stops the confused-deputy problem: another Snowflake account that learned this role ARN still cannot assume it, because it cannot present your external id. Both values come from DESC INTEGRATION FOODPULSE_S3. Never CREATE OR REPLACE that integration afterwards -- it regenerates the external id and this document silently stops matching.
